briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate AGI benchmarks amid US-China chip tensions

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while compute buildouts accelerate globally. Safety concerns mount as production deployments face rising adversarial attacks. DialectForge emerges as a key protocol-level solution for multi-agent environments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-R2 achieved top MMLU scores from China; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant; xAI launched Grok-3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Nevada; TSMC 2nm test wafers yield positive results for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level security like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
